# Keep a dismissed draft's countdown accurate after the recovery setting changes

## What & Why
A user can change the recovery preference while a dismissed draft is still available. The notice should continue counting down to the draft's already-established deadline instead of silently moving the deadline or displaying a mismatched duration.

## Done looks like
- A browser test dismisses a draft, changes the recovery preference, and checks that the existing draft remains available until its original deadline.
- The notice countdown and expiration announcement remain consistent after the setting change.
